title: SLOs-Serve: Optimized Serving of Multi-SLO LLMs
technique: multi-SLO dynamic-programming scheduler for token allocation (chunked prefill, optional speculative decoding, dynamic batch size) with soft admission control, burst-resilient scheduling and multi-replica routing

optimized_metrics.evidence: Our goal is to maximize serving capacity, the maximum request load each GPU can process while maintaining a target SLO attainment rate (e.g., 90% attainment).
The scheduling algorithm optimizes batch schedules to maximize the total value gained from attaining requests' SLO.
Every request has a deadline for its prefill stage pDDL_i.
optimized_metrics.stat_quote: Every request has a deadline for its prefill stage pDDL_i ... We say that a request's SLO is attained if and only if the SLO for every stage is satisfied.

optimized_metrics.evidence: For the decode stage, a request can enforce the TPOT SLO for every token from a vector of choices TPOT_1, TPOT_2, ..., TPOT_L. We say that a request's SLO is attained if and only if the SLO for every stage is satisfied.
optimized_metrics.stat_quote: a request can enforce the TPOT SLO for every token ... We say that a request's SLO is attained if and only if the SLO for every stage is satisfied.

headline_claim.text: SLOs-Serve improves per-GPU serving capacity by 2.2x on average compared to prior state-of-the-art systems.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 1, 9 serving capacity (max load per GPU at 90% attainment)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: serving capacity (defined as the maximum request load per GPU while maintaining 90% SLO attainment)
metric_definitions.notes: per-GPU, request-rate based; the paper's goodput analogue

metric_definitions.definition_quote: We say that a request's SLO is attained if and only if the SLO for every stage is satisfied.
metric_definitions.notes: multi-stage: prefill deadline plus per-token TPOT SLOs (and thinking stage for reasoning)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: The prefill stage (input processing, reasoning, tool interaction) is measured by Time-To-First-Token (TTFT), which impacts user wait time. The decode stage (token generation) is measured by Time-Per-Output-Token (TPOT), affecting response delivery speed.
metric_definitions.notes: stage-dependent; TTFT also covers reasoning/tool stages in agentic cases; queueing implied by deadline

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we focus on the max TTFT slowdown compared to zero-load setup for the prefill stages and max TPOT for the decode stages. Because speculative decoding outputs more than one token at a time, we measure the TPOT every 10 tokens.
metric_definitions.notes: TTFT SLO is a slowdown factor vs zero-load prefill latency (scales with prompt length); TPOT SLO checked on max across tokens (every 10 tokens), i.e. a worst-case-token style constraint rather than a request mean

slo_spec: Application- and stage-specific SLOs from Table 1: e.g. summarization tight prefill/loose decode, coder normal prefill/fast decode, chatbot reading-speed decode, reasoning tight thinking stage; TTFT SLO set as max slowdown vs zero-load latency, TPOT as max over every-10-token windows; target 90% attainment for capacity.
load_regime: trace replay (Azure LLM inference traces: bursty Coding, stable Chatting) scaled to request load; capacity search; multi-replica scaling
tradeoff_acknowledged: Prefill-prioritising (vLLM) causes TPOT violations; decode-prioritising (Sarathi) causes TTFT violations; requests with unattainable SLOs are delayed/demoted to best-effort under bursts to protect the rest.
hardware: Google a2-highgpu-4g (4x A100 40GB), a3-highgpu-8g (8x H100 80GB) for multi-replica
workloads: Azure LLM traces with ShareGPT, HumanEval, Arxiv Summary, ToolBench, s1K prompts; six scenarios
extractor_notes: Capacity metric is per-GPU request load at 90% attainment (not tokens/s). TTFT SLO defined as slowdown relative to zero-load latency, and TPOT SLO evaluated as max over 10-token windows - both differ from common mean TPOT. Text layout is two-column; locators approximate.
load_class_quote: We used Azure LLM inference traces [25] for realistic request arrival patterns: Coding shows bursty arrivals ... (§5.1)
repass_log: TTFT/TPOT constraints: design; stat n/a->attainment explicit (per-request deadline attainment)
